sentences.en: The demolition site is covered with plastic mesh to keep down the dust.
sentences.zh: 拆除现场覆盖着塑料网以抑制扬尘。

sentences.en: Well over three thousand people signed to prevent the demolition of this historic building.
sentences.zh: 有三千多人签名反对拆毁这座历史建筑。

sentences.en: All demolition charges have been deactivated.
sentences.zh: 所有与拆除有关的费用都已失效。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：de（相反）+mol（堆）+ition（行为）→不成堆→破坏
